verdict: APPROVE the packet bindings for later use. It is exactly the reviewed pieces and nothing else. The KC is candidate-011's rev002 regression KC with the single PDSerialHID member replaced by the hardware-enumerated PDM1SPIHID SDK005. The RAM is 009's RAM minus the host-HID terminal, plus the read-only inventory and native observer, with the keyboard-only compositor and native supervisor substituted. The build record carries the exact native opt-in that the isolated host 09cd requires and none of the host-HID opt-ins. This is not a runtime authorisation. The gates stay as root stated: a qualified 011, then 09cd applied to root and M5 with source closure and manifest verified, then one boot with mandatory Linux recovery.

notes.text: The active host b260bff9 has no native gate. Run offline against this packet, it accepts it as a plain desktop run (desktop true, everything else false): no sealed writer, no pdm1kbd=1 boot argument (so PDM1SPIHID would not start and the inventory would return BLOCKED 77) and no native fields in console-result. Such a run cannot qualify. Apply the reviewed 09cd before booting this packet, as root planned, and require console-result native_keyboard_desktop_enabled true and native_mode_host_write_phase 'sealed'.

In addition to the native-startup-supervisor-review rules: allowed lines are 'BSD wait error=3' + 'BSD ready seen=1 elapsed_ms~60000' if PDM1SPIHID starts before BSD (011 measured 60060), or a single 'BSD ready seen=0 elapsed_ms=0' if it starts after devfs. Forbidden: 'BSD wait refused', 'publication refused', any 'ready kind=2' or '/dev/usb_hid_mouse', any PDSerialHID line. 'ready kind=1 attempts=1' requires PDM1SPIHID descriptor acceptance in the same console. early_drops=0 does not prove that no input preceded the endpoint (rev002 N2).

PDKeyStore is the only shared entry not byte-identical to its 011 bytes (relocated +0xc000; every change accounted for). The KC as a whole is new, so 011's runtime result carries over to the publication lifecycle and the 47 identical entries, not to the composition as a whole.

The PDM1SPIHID build hook adds add_subdirectory without the add_dependencies(kexts ...) line the neighbouring kexts use. This has no effect here, because SDK005 is a separate derivation and the KC takes its output by store path.
